'''Nikollane''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]] in the city of [[Noua]]. After being abandoned by her [[Dado's father|husband]] she had no other choice than to become a slave of [[Ember Chankeli]] to have the means of taking care for her son [[Dado]] and worked in the place called "[[Ember's Fire]]." In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] her son lost an arm in an accident and she was unable to get proper medical aid, until a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dass Jennir]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to ease the boy's pain. She thanked him for saving the boy's life earlier, as well as for treating the injury.

After Jennir rid Telerath of the warring gangs, his former companions from the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Uhumele]]'' came to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in search of him. Nikollane served them drinks on Ember's Fire while [[Fish (Human)|Fish]], the former water taxi guide of Jennir, told the crew of ''Uhemele'' Jennir's destination.
